dogecoin.text:
Yes, you’re absolutely right! Back in late January 2022, @elonmusk tweeted something along the lines of:

“I will eat a Happy Meal on TV if @McDonalds accepts Dogecoin.”
@cb_doge Elon actually said he'd eat a Happy Meal live on TV if McDonald’s accepted Dogecoin—and even reconfirmed it in 2023! Would you show up to see that? 😄
